description: M5 item 1 — Dunit GPT partition policy. Proof that a disk built by tools/install_disk.py per the Dunit GPT policy (kernel/src/storage/policy.rs) presents a DUNIT-SYSTEM partition whose type GUID the kernel recognises, and that dunitfs::auto_mount selects the root BY that policy GUID (kind=system) rather than by blind superblock probing. Run with: tools/qemu_test.py --build-disk --config limine_test_terminal.conf --markers-file tools/m5_gpt_policy_markers.json

required.claim: auto_mount selected the DunitFS root BY the Dunit System policy type GUID (single source of truth: kernel/src/storage/policy.rs)
installed DunitFS root mounted from disk at /persist
the installed disk boots to the terminal
